name: Oversees the Veil
description: You possess high-level clearance and the ability to access and control vast amounts of classified information.
connectionOptions: One PC was involved in an operation you personally authorized.
You have been monitoring one PC due to their potential anomalous nature.
One PC's family member worked for you in the past.
You suspect one PC might be a security risk and are discreetly investigating them.

abilities.name: Classified Knowledge
abilities.description: You're trained in all tasks related to recalling classified information about anomalies, the Foundation, or global conspiracies.

abilities.name: Secure Line
abilities.description: You can establish a secure communication channel to request information or resources once per day.

abilities.name: Tactical Oversight
abilities.description: You can spend 3 Intellect points to give all allies an asset on their next action by providing high-level tactical information.

abilities.name: Reality Revision
abilities.description: Once per day, you can attempt to make a small change to reality by editing official records and manipulating information flows. This is a difficult Intellect task.

abilities.name: Contingency Activation
abilities.description: You can activate a pre-planned contingency measure to deal with a current threat. This could involve calling in special forces, activating secret protocols, or revealing hidden resources.

abilities.name: Veil Enforcement
abilities.description: You can attempt to enforce the veil on a large scale, erasing or altering public knowledge of an event. This is a challenging task that may require multiple rolls and have unforeseen consequences.

abilities.name: Reality Anchor Override
abilities.description: Once per session, you can override reality anchors in a large area, either stabilizing or destabilizing reality as needed. The effects are powerful but may have significant unforeseen consequences.
